content.short: EZManager opens, rebalances and tracks concentrated liquidity positions automatically.
content.description: EZManager handles the full lifecycle of a concentrated liquidity position: opening it, moving the range as price drifts, collecting fees and reporting true profit and loss. A pool explorer lets a provider filter, compare and shortlist pools before committing capital. Automation covers range, capital and fee actions once a position is live. It works across several DEXs and chains, with an SDK for programmatic use and documented workflows for AI agent strategies. A companion product, EZMoney, packages the same automation as a managed LP yield product.
content.meta: Opens and rebalances concentrated liquidity ranges so positions keep earning as price moves.
